name: Residents experiencing homelessness
source: Monterey County 2024 Homelessness Point-In-Time Count, Applied Survey Research; denominator: California DOF population estimate reproduced in the County's 2025–26 Legislative Platform
notes: The opened PIT report identifies 2,436 people experiencing homelessness in Monterey County on January 31, 2024 (report lines/page 12). The opened County 2025–26 Legislative Platform states that California DOF estimated Monterey County population at 437,614 in 2024 (PDF page 6): https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/138247/638736919326900000. Calculation: 2,436 ÷ 437,614 × 10,000 = 55.7. The PIT study is produced by Applied Survey Research for the local Continuum of Care; capture helper attempts timed out connecting to chsp.org, so snapshot_path is empty and no evidence file was saved. This is a Monterey County proxy permitted by the configured scale policy; it is not a Carmel-by-the-Sea city-limit rate.
